# Rusty

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P23](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0023)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044)</sub>

## Appearance

Rusty is a cat who initially has a lank, thin, and disreputable appearance, with draggled, unsightly fur of a rusty-brown, singed-black hue. Early on, he is missing pieces of both ears, has one swollen jowl, and suffers from an eye temporarily out of repair. Over time, his condition improves until he becomes plump, glossy, and tolerably respectable.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P13](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0013), [v3 ch.Relationships P48](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0048)_

## History

Rusty was a persistent stray cat who was adopted by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends at Patty's Place after he survived a failed attempt to chloroform him. On [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#spofford-avenue), he vanquished every aristocratic feline one by one, including a pitched battle in which he routed the tobacco king's cat. Following initial turf wars with Aunt Jamesina's incoming pets, Rusty accepted the [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)-cat's dominance and formed a close friendship with [Joseph](../character/joseph.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P14](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0014), [v3 ch.Relationships P23](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0023), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), [v3 ch.Relationships P48](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0048), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), +4 more_

Rusty is a stray cat adopted by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends at Patty's Place after a failed attempt to chloroform him. ### [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/joseph--rusty.md)

[Joseph](../character/joseph.md) is one of Aunt Jamesina's cats who moved into Patty's Place alongside Rusty. After an initial adjustment period marked by turf wars and squabbles, the two cats overcame their conflict to become sworn friends who sleep together and wash each other's faces.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P14](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0014), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), +5 more_
